-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies MinIO credentials and connectivity.

list-buckets.name: list-buckets
list-buckets.description: List all buckets in the MinIO server

params.bucket: Name of the bucket to create (lowercase, 3-63 chars)
params.region: Region for the bucket (optional, default: us-east-1)

params.bucket: Name of the bucket to delete
Name of the bucket to check

list-objects.name: list-objects
list-objects.description: List objects in a bucket with optional prefix filter

params.limit: Maximum number of objects to return (default: 100)

upload-object.name: upload-object
upload-object.description: Upload a file or content to a bucket

params.objectName: Name/path for the object in the bucket
params.filePath: Local file path to upload (use this OR content)
params.content: String content to upload (use this OR filePath)

download-object.name: download-object
download-object.description: Download an object from a bucket

params.objectName: Name/path of the object to download

delete-object.name: delete-object
delete-object.description: Delete an object from a bucket

params.objectName: Name/path of the object to delete

copy-object.name: copy-object
copy-object.description: Copy an object within or between buckets

get-presigned-url.name: get-presigned-url
get-presigned-url.description: Generate a presigned URL for temporary access to an object

params.expiry: URL expiry time in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour, max: 604800 = 7 days)

get-object-info.name: get-object-info
get-object-info.description: Get metadata/info about an object (size, type, etag, etc.)

name: MinIO
description: MinIO S3-compatible object storage - manage buckets, upload/download objects, generate presigned URLs

changelog.notes: Initial release — manage buckets, upload, download, copy and delete files, and create temporary shareable links
